question: Article _______ of the Constitution of India lays down that the State shall endeavour to secure for the citizens a uniform civil code throughout the territory of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**44**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Uniform Civil Code**

 
 
• A uniform civil code is one that will provide **a law for the whole country, which will apply to all religious communities in their personal matters like marriage, divorce, heritage, adoption etc.**
 
• **Article 44** of the Constitution of India lays down that the **State shall endeavour to secure for the citizens a uniform civil code** throughout the territory of India.
 
• It aims** to provide protection to the weaker sections **as envisaged by Ambedkar, including women and religious minorities, while also promotes nationalist enthusiasm through unity.
